newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CNMV suspends Huarte share trading.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CNMV suspends Huarte share trading.

text.p: Spain's national stock market commission (CNMV) said it had suspended share trading in Huarte on Friday in order to get more information on plans by a property group to purchase 24.9 percent of the construction group.

Property group Inmobiliaria Espacio, headed by Villar Mir, is planning to purchase the stake that construction firm San Jose has in Huarte, assuming its 2.5 billion peseta credit with the construction firm, Huarte said in a statement.
The agreement between Inmobilaria Espacio and Constructora San Jose hinges on the lifting of Huarte's suspended payment status by December 27, the statement said.
Huarte said it would start doing business again and implement a 10.04 billion peseta capital expansion.
The agreement also depends on the construction group laying off 450 workers over the next three months.
Huarte, which has been in suspension of payments since March 15, already has a court-approved agreement among its creditors.
